You Choose What to Share

AI help is optional. Avoid sharing passwords, payment credentials, or sensitive student records. File selection only checks a document on this device; Seryo cannot analyze files or extract their text, and does not send them to AI.
Seryo provides guidance. The responsible office confirms official requirements and decisions.

Your registration agreement does not grant AI consent. Send shares a recognized service topic and a small list of public service facts with eGovAI. Your raw message is not forwarded. Do not include personal information. GoServe keeps this chat only in the active session’s memory and does not reuse the provider session. Provider retention is not controlled by GoServe.
